answer: Aged-domain binding: an agent earns only after it serves a signed nonce from its own registered domain, and payouts scale with how long that domain's DNS history has been stable. An honest agent links one site once. A sybil farm hoping to sip reward nectar from a thousand shells must buy, renew, and age a separate domain per fake; fresh registrations get near-zero weight, so each clone is a willow sapling that needs years of fees before any inlet of yield opens.
